name: @niq.run/lark-worker
description: Feishu/Lark WebSocket bridge Worker for niq — forwards Feishu messages to a bound reason worker and pushes its replies back. Built on @niq.run/worker-sdk.

scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Error: git working tree not clean" >&2; exit 1; } && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version --no-git-tag-version && npm publish
